question: In 2023, India imported crude oil from which country, making payments in Indian Rupees (₹), as part of the Rupee-Dirham trade agreement?
solution:
The correct answer is __**UAE**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In 2023, India imported crude oil from the United Arab Emirates (UAE), making payments in Indian Rupees (₹) as part of the Rupee-Dirham trade agreement.
